page_title: BAR 2-1 BIL | Barcelona v Athletic Bilbao 24/08/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

raw: Ruiz de Galarreta I. Calf Injury

commentary.text: 90+7' The referee blows his whistle for the final time to end this match.
90+6' Mikel Jauregizar (Ath Bilbao) protests to the referee and receives a yellow card.
90+6' Fermin Lopez (Barcelona) is booked for saying more than Jesus Gil Manzano was willing to tolerate.
90+6' Jesus Gil Manzano shows a yellow card to Ander Herrera (Ath Bilbao) for a tough tackle.
90+1' Substitution. Alejandro Balde will be replaced by Gerard Martin (Barcelona).
90+1' Here is a change. Lamine Yamal is going off and Hansi Flick gives the last tactical orders to Pau Victor (Barcelona).
90' There will be a minimum of 5 min. of added time.
87' Inigo Lekue (Ath Bilbao) can't expect anything else than a yellow card for his hard tackle. And a yellow it is. Jesus Gil Manzano didn't think twice about pulling it out of his pocket.
85' Robert Lewandowski (Barcelona) is awarded a yellow card for his tackle. He doesn't seem to agree with the decision, but Jesus Gil Manzano ignores the protests.
83' Substitution. Eric Garcia (Barcelona) replaces Marc Bernal.
78' Ernesto Valverde Tejedor has decided to make a change. Ander Herrera (Ath Bilbao) replaces Benat Prados Diaz.
78' The substitution is prepared. Gorka Guruzeta (Ath Bilbao) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Inaki Williams.
76' It’s hot out there so the ref signals there will be a cooling break for the players to take on some fluids.
75' 2 - 1 Goal! Robert Lewandowski (Barcelona) was in the right place at the right time to get to the rebound inside the box and gleefully rifles the ball low inside the right post. It's 2:1.
74' A snap shot by Benat Prados Diaz (Ath Bilbao) from the edge of the area flies towards the bottom left corner, but Marc-Andre ter Stegen produces a good save to thwart him.
73' Nico Williams (Ath Bilbao) takes the corner kick and sends a lovely ball into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence is ready and knocks the ball to safety.
73' The ball is cleared after Inaki Williams (Ath Bilbao) attempted to dribble past an opposing player. The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Ath Bilbao.
72' It will be a substitution. Adu Ares (Ath Bilbao) is ready to enter the pitch as Alex Berenguer walks off.
71' Jules Kounde slings in a great lofted ball towards Robert Lewandowski (Barcelona), who doesn't get the best of contacts but still sends a close-range header inches wide of the left post.
70' A cross is clipped into the penalty area by Lamine Yamal (Barcelona) but poses no threat.
70' Raphinha (Barcelona) takes a short corner kick.
70' Raphinha (Barcelona) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away. The ball goes out of play and Barcelona have been awarded a corner kick.
69' Inaki Williams (Ath Bilbao) finds himself beyond the last defender, but the game is stopped by the referee after the linesman signals for offside.
64' Robert Lewandowski (Barcelona) latches onto a cross inside the box and aims a shot towards the middle of the goal, but Alex Padilla reacts superbly to deny him.
63' Substitution. Ferran Torres leaves the pitch and is replaced by Fermin Lopez (Barcelona).
63' Ernesto Valverde Tejedor decides to make a substitution. Mikel Vesga will be replaced by Mikel Jauregizar (Ath Bilbao).
62' Substitution. Oihan Sancet makes his way off the pitch and Unai Gomez (Ath Bilbao) comes on as his replacement.
62' Raphinha (Barcelona) swings in a promising cross from the free kick, but one of the defenders does a perfect job to avert the danger.

61' Dani Vivian (Ath Bilbao) should know this behaviour is beyond the rules. He was too careless with his challenge and left Jesus Gil Manzano no option but to blow his whistle. A free kick to Barcelona.
61' Alex Berenguer (Ath Bilbao) takes the corner, but the goalkeeper jumps and gathers the ball.

60' Oihan Sancet (Ath Bilbao) places a shot from the edge of the box towards the top of the net, but Marc-Andre ter Stegen makes a terrific save to deny him. Nice play all round! Ath Bilbao force their opponents to concede a corner.
60' The attendance is 46448.
57' Robert Lewandowski (Barcelona) creates himself some space in front of goal and connects with the resulting free kick. His almost perfect header hits the right post and ricochets away off it.
57' It seemed like Raphinha (Barcelona) was going to take a quick free kick, but instead he is going to send the ball inside the penalty box for his teammates.
56' Alex Berenguer (Ath Bilbao) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Jesus Gil Manzano had an easy-decision to make.
51' The linesman signals that Jules Kounde (Barcelona) is offside and the referee confirms the decision.
49' The foul by Marc Bernal (Barcelona) is worthy of a card and a yellow is duly shown by Jesus Gil Manzano.
46' Everything is set for the start of the second half.
45+7' The match has reached half-time.
45+6' Lamine Yamal (Barcelona) commits a foul and Jesus Gil Manzano immediately signals a free kick.
45+4' Raphinha (Barcelona) fires a shot at goal from a very promising position outside the penalty area, but it is blocked by a self-sacrificing defender.
45+2' The corner from Raphinha (Barcelona) is intercepted by Alex Padilla.
45' 6 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
42' 1 - 1 GOAL! That’s a perfect strike from the spot by Oihan Sancet (Ath Bilbao) into the top right hand corner, giving goalkeeper Marc-Andre ter Stegen no chance!
42' Oihan Sancet (Ath Bilbao) is heading towards the penalty spot to take it.
41' Pau Cubarsi (Barcelona) sees a yellow card from Jesus Gil Manzano after he sent one of the opposing players to the ground.
41' The Ath Bilbao players are happy as the referee awards a PENALTY after the VAR review!
41' Celebrations by Ath Bilbao are cut short as the referee signals that the penalty decision will be checked using the VAR. Hopefully it won’t take too long.
40' Robert Lewandowski (Barcelona) goes down in the box after a challenge from the defender. Possibly unsighted, the referee just waves play on.
39' Alex Berenguer (Ath Bilbao) breaks into the box and goes over after a challenge from an opposition player, but the ref signals NO penalty!
38' A yellow card for a tackle by Yeray Alvarez (Ath Bilbao). Jesus Gil Manzano doesn't hesitate at all to make this decision.
37' Robert Lewandowski (Barcelona) expertly controls a neat clever pass inside the box, but his effort crashes against the right post! What an opportunity that was!
32' It’s time for the cooling break for the players to take on some fluids. It’s hot out there!
31' The goalkeeper punched the ball away after Alex Berenguer (Ath Bilbao) took the corner.
31' Inaki Williams (Ath Bilbao) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge. The ball is out of play and Ath Bilbao manage to earn a corner.
29' The foul by Pau Cubarsi (Barcelona) was seen by Jesus Gil Manzano who didn't hesitate to blow the whistle.
28' Raphinha (Barcelona) quickly takes the corner kick with a short pass.
27' Nico Williams (Ath Bilbao) clips a neat ball into the box in the direction of Alex Berenguer, but he can't get on the end of the pass.
26' Here comes the VAR decision. The goal is given and Barcelona players have a reason to celebrate!
25' Wait! Referee Jesus Gil Manzano has indicated he is going to review the Barcelona goal using VAR. It’s probably to see if there was an offside in the build-up.

24' 1 - 0 GOAL 1:0! Lamine Yamal (Barcelona) brilliantly slaloms his way forward past a few defenders and unleashes a shot from the edge of the box, which is deflected and goes into the back of the net.
24' It seemed like Pedri (Barcelona) was going to take a quick free kick, but instead he is going to send the ball inside the penalty box for his teammates.

24' Referee Jesus Gil Manzano sees the trip by Alex Berenguer (Ath Bilbao) and doesn't hesitate to blow his whistle. It's a free kick to Barcelona, but they probably won't attempt a direct shot on goal from here.
21' Alex Berenguer (Ath Bilbao) takes the corner and sends it into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence is ready and makes a good clearance.

21' Nico Williams (Ath Bilbao) receives a neat pass inside the box and instantly thumps the ball goalward, but a defender makes a last ditch block to deny him. The ball goes out of play. Ath Bilbao are awarded a corner kick.

20' A defence-splitting pass is taken in his stride by Raphinha (Barcelona) in the box. Without even looking up he drills a shot towards the middle of the goal, but Alex Padilla pulls off an easy save.
18' Dani Vivian (Ath Bilbao) connects with the corner kick around the penalty spot, but steers his header just wide of the left post.
18' Alex Berenguer (Ath Bilbao) goes over to take a corner kick after one of the defenders makes a good clearance.
16' Pedri (Barcelona) lifts the ball into the box from the corner, but one of the defending players gets there first to head it clear.
16' Jules Kounde (Barcelona) decides to speed play up by quickly sending the free kick into the box.
15' Yuri Berchiche (Ath Bilbao) makes an overly-aggressive challenge and Jesus Gil Manzano blows his whistle for a foul. Barcelona will take a free kick.
13' Lamine Yamal (Barcelona) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Alex Padilla, who smothers the ball.
13' Raphinha (Barcelona) decides to speed play up with a short corner kick.

13' Raphinha (Barcelona) attempts to find one of his teammates with a sweet pass into the box, but one of the defending players reacts well and intercepts the effort. The ball is out of play. Barcelona will have a chance to score from a corner.
11' Ferran Torres (Barcelona) shoots from the edge of the penalty area. The ball travels low towards the middle of the target, but Alex Padilla easily deals with the threat.
9' A great solo run by Nico Williams (Ath Bilbao) took him deep inside the box, but his weak effort towards the bottom left corner was easily caught by Marc-Andre ter Stegen.
8' Alex Berenguer (Ath Bilbao) decides to strike the ball towards goal, but his effort fails to threaten the goalkeeper after being blocked by one of the defenders.
5' Alex Berenguer (Ath Bilbao) takes the corner with a short pass.
5' Nico Williams (Ath Bilbao) tries to send a pass but it's blocked. Ath Bilbao get a corner.
2' Inaki Williams (Ath Bilbao) is caught offside!
1' Here we go, today's match is starting right now.
The players are out and the match is about to start. Ath Bilbao will have the kick-off.
